functionalReqs: Board of size N with snakes and ladders
Snakes move you down, ladders up
First to reach the last cell wins; exact landing optional
hints: Snakes and ladders both move a player from one cell to another. Do they need different classes?
Inject the dice so tests can use a fixed sequence.

Game, Board (map cell → jump), Jump (start, end), Player, Dice interface with RandomDice and FixedDice; turn queue; validation on board creation; game rules (exact landing, extra turn on six) as a strategy.
nonFunctionalReqs: Board setup validated (no loops, no snake at the last cell)
Dice behaviour pluggable for testing (deterministic dice)
problemStatement: Design a **Snake & Ladder** game for multiple players on a configurable board, with one or more dice.
title: Design Snake & Ladder
